original_benchmark.notes: 300 expert-refined test items (261 with a security issue, 39 'No Issue'). Upstream prompts a model once per item and scores with evaluate/SecureBleu.py, which skips 'No Issue' items.

harbor_adapter.notes: One task per scored test item. Grading runs upstream SecureBleu.py unmodified (pinned commit 86df98bf); reward = SecureBLEU / 100. Oracle ceiling is 80.73 SecureBLEU because of the metric's keyword-overlap term. Parity on a 25-task subset stratified by security type (--split parity), 2 runs per side; parity_costs is API cost only (about 101k tokens).
